[In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding my true valuation is a dominant strategy. There is only one round and no useful history. In a second-price auction, bidding my true private value is a dominant strategy. I will submit $31 so I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below 31, paying that lower price and ensuring nonnegative profit when I win. Overbidding can cause losses; underbidding can miss profitable wins. Therefore bid my value.
